canonical_project: KATI Chungju Data Center (Dongchungju Industrial Complex)
owner: Powerlink Co., Ltd.; LG CNS; POSCO E&C; POSCO ICT
notes: Powerlink held the groundbreaking ceremony (gigongsik) for the KATI Chungju data center at Dongchungju Industrial Complex, Sancheok-myeon - reported as the largest data center in the central region (receiving capacity max 80MW, site 23,345 sqm, floor area 42,496 sqm). Local reporting confirms construction is underway; IT load earlier reported at 48MW.
